mapper.sql: a.id, a.type_id, t.name AS type_name, a.name, a.description, a.location, a.start_at, a.end_at, a.registration_deadline, a.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id) AS registered_count, a.publication_state, a.published_at, a.live_url, a.cover_storage_key, a.cover_content_type, a.created_by, a.version, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at
CASE WHEN a.publication_state = 'DRAFT' THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN a.end_at <= #{now} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN a.registration_deadline <= #{now} THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'REGISTERING' END

sql.if: AND (a.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR a.location LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity a JOIN activity_type t ON t.id = a.type_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.type_id, (SELECT t.name FROM activity_type t WHERE t.id = a.type_id) AS type_name, a.name, a.description, a.location, a.start_at, a.end_at, a.registration_deadline, a.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r WHERE r.activity_id = a.id) AS registered_count, a.publication_state, a.published_at, a.live_url, a.cover_storage_key, a.cover_content_type, a.created_by, a.version, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at FROM activity a WHERE a.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM activity a JOIN activity_type t ON t.id = a.type_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN display_status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN display_status = 'REGISTERING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS registering, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN display_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN display_status = 'ENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ended FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN publication_state = 'DRAFT' THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN end_at <= #{now} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN registration_deadline <= #{now} THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'REGISTERING' END AS display_status FROM activity WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ) counted

SELECT FROM activity a JOIN activity_type t ON t.id = a.type_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.publication_state = 'DRAFT' THEN 2 WHEN a.end_at <= #{now} THEN 3 WHEN a.registration_deadline <= #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, a.start_at FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
